recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-31816 change for the current build's ModelInfo example without broad regeneration of unrelated stale ModelInfo content; remaining old MedicinalProduct* model metadata should be reconciled only under their own Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-31816 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for BR&R. It reported that specifiedSubstance should not repeat because a single ingredient cannot have multiple substances; the final disposition was to change and simplify the Substance/SpecifiedSubstance modeling for R5.
initial_application: The explicit Jira-tagged implementation commit 5730009f8bc3d8edcbaba2bbf979741b55017c7b removed Ingredient.specifiedSubstance, made Ingredient.substance mandatory, and removed specified-substance examples and search parameters for the FHIR-31816 issue family. The current Ingredient StructureDefinition keeps Ingredient.substance at 1..1 and has no Ingredient.specifiedSubstance element.
additional_context: MedicinalProductIngredient now maps to Ingredient in source/fhir.ini, and both Ingredient and Library are active resources. The Library examples include source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml as the FHIR ModelInfo XML; before reconciliation, that active ModelInfo still exposed MedicinalProductIngredient.specifiedSubstance as a list and still defined MedicinalProductIngredient.SpecifiedSubstance. BR&R minutes confirmed the FHIR-31816 persuasive vote and simplified-model rationale. FHIR-31876 is the same change family and already has a separate reconcile audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml by removing the stale MedicinalProductIngredient.specifiedSubstance element and the unreferenced MedicinalProductIngredient.SpecifiedSubstance ModelInfo class. No changes were needed to Ingredient StructureDefinition, examples, or search parameters because those source files already reflect the applied modeling change.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: removed the stale MedicinalProductIngredient.specifiedSubstance ModelInfo element and MedicinalProductIngredient.SpecifiedSubstance class.
